title: 气候评分：类别、权重与 essential criteria
summary: 气候评分含 17 个评分类别，权重仅用于管理与领导力层；essential criteria 横跨 Awareness 到 A 名单四层。
sourceNote: 本页按 CDP 官方文件整理；悬浮「原文」可查看对应官方原文。正式填报请以 CDP 当期气候评分方法为准。

sections.title: 气候评分的 17 个评分类别

blocks.title: 高权重代表类别（全部共 17 类）

cards.title: Targets 目标
cards.content: 定量目标与进展，权重最高之一。

cards.title: Governance 治理
cards.content: 董事会层面的气候监督与职责。

cards.title: Business Strategy 战略
cards.content: 将气候纳入前瞻战略与财务决策。

cards.title: Scope 1 & 2 排放
cards.content: 范围一、范围二排放核算与绩效。

cards.title: Scope 3 排放
cards.content: 价值链范围三排放披露。

cards.title: Verification 核查
cards.content: 排放第三方核证，保障数据质量。

blocks.content_cn: 气候评分共 17 个类别，2025 与 2026 之间类别与权重未变；金融服务业另含 Portfolio Impact 共 18 类。

quote.text: There are 17 categories in CDP’s full corporate scoring methodology for climate change - general. No changes were made to the climate change scoring category weightings between 2025 and 2026.

blocks.content_cn: 评分类别是问题按主题的分组；权重仅应用于管理与领导力两层，反映各类别对行业的重要性。

quote.text: Scoring categories are groupings of questions by topic. They are sub-groups of the 2026 questionnaire modules and are consistent across all sectors. Weightings are applied to scoring categories at the Management and Leadership levels only.

blocks.content_cn: 金融服务业有 18 个类别，含独有的高权重 Portfolio Impact 类别。

quote.text: There are 18 categories in CDP’s full corporate scoring methodology for financial services.

sections.title: 气候 essential criteria 四层级

steps.title: Awareness
steps.desc: 基础认知层，需满足最低披露门槛

steps.title: Leadership
steps.desc: 最佳实践透明度与绩效

cards.content: 气候的 essential criteria 横跨 Awareness、Management、Leadership 与 A 名单四层，用于设定一致的披露基线。

quote.text: Essential criteria are present for Climate Change across Awareness, Management, Leadership and A list.

sections.title: 关键 essential criteria 速查

rows: 董事会层对气候议题的监督与胜任
拥有温控对齐转型计划或两年内制定
披露范围一、范围二（含位置法）排放
披露范围三各相关类别的基准年排放
范围一、二核证≥95%（领导层）/100%（A 名单）
近期减排目标获 SBTi 认证或年降≥4.2%

cards.content: 2026 年移除了 EC-CC1 与 EC-CC2 在管理与领导力层的要求，其余内容基本不变。

quote.text: Organizations must have a temperature aligned transition plan or plans to develop a climate transition plan within two years.

sections.title: 与 SBTi 净零目标衔接

cards.content: 气候 A 名单的近期目标可被 SBTi 认证的科学碳目标满足；范围三目标亦与净零路径挂钩。

quote.text: The Scope 1 and 2 target(s) has/(have) been approved as science-based by the Science Based Target initiative in question 7.53.1.

cards.content: 范围一、二披露是气候评分的硬门槛；这与各准则对范围一、二计量的要求一致。

quote.text: Organization must disclose Scope 1 emissions figures and Scope 2 emissions figures for the reporting year, including Scope 2 location-based emissions figures and, if applicable to the organizations, Scope 2 market-based figures.

related.text: 直接（范围1）温室气体排放总量以二氧化碳(CO2)当量公吨数表示。
related.label: 关联知识：GRI 305 排放

cards.content: 披露净排放量目标时，须同时单独披露排放总量目标——这与财政部准则口径一致。

quote.text: At Leadership level, organizations must have at least 95% of reported Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions and at least one Scope 3 category verified/assured by third-party.

related.text: 目标是温室气体排放总量目标还是净排放量目标。如果企业披露温室气体净排放量目标，则还应当单独披露相关温室气体排放总量目标。
related.source: 财政部《企业可持续披露准则第1号——气候（试行）》 第四十二条
related.label: 关联知识：财政部气候准则 第四十二条
